exercises.question: Which sentence gives a cause and a consequence?
options: Hubo un retraso porque faltaban unos documentos. [There was a delay because some documents were missing.]
Hubo un retraso en la entrega de los documentos. [There was a delay in the delivery of the documents.]
Habrá un retraso en la entrega del informe. [There will be a delay in the delivery of the report.]

exercises.sentence: Hubo un __ porque faltaban unos documentos.
exercises.english: There was a delay because some documents were missing.
Because of an error in the report, we had to repeat the analysis.

sentences: Primero apareció un problema. [First a problem appeared.]
Después identificamos la causa. [Then we identified the cause.]
Finalmente encontramos una solución. [Finally we found a solution.]

options: Hubo un retraso porque faltaba un documento. [There was a delay because a document was missing.]
Hubo un retraso, por eso faltaba un documento. [There was a delay, so a document was missing.]
Hubo un retraso porque faltará un documento. [There was a delay because a document will be missing.]

exercises.question: What does «por eso» introduce? [¿Qué introduce «por eso»?]
options: a consequence [una consecuencia]
a cause [una causa]
a condition [una condición]

exercises.sentence: El plazo era muy corto, por eso __ que trabajar más rápido.
exercises.english: The deadline was very short, so we had to work faster.
The team found a solution, so we were able to finish the project.

options: Because of an error in the report, we had to repeat the analysis.
Because of a delay in the report, we had to repeat the analysis.
Because of an error in the report, we decided to skip the analysis.

exercises.sentence: El plazo era muy corto, por eso tuvimos que trabajar más rápido.

exercises.question: Choose the correct cause connector. [Elige el conector correcto de causa.]
options: Debido a un error, tuvimos que repetir el trabajo. [Because of an error, we had to repeat the work.]
Debido a hubo un error, tuvimos que repetir el trabajo. [Because of there was an error, we had to repeat the work.]
Porque un error, tuvimos que repetir el trabajo. [Because an error, we had to repeat the work.]

options: El plazo era corto, así que trabajamos más rápido. [The deadline was short, so we worked faster.]
El plazo era corto, porque trabajamos más rápido. [The deadline was short because we worked faster.]
